data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin providing native PDFView widgets on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: It renders PDF files natively on Android and iOS devices using a dedicated PDFView widget. It offers controller options for pagination, zooming, page sizing, and screenshots, as well as various callbacks for rendering and page changes.
use_when: You need to display local or data-driven PDF files inside your Flutter app on Android and iOS.
You require native rendering performance for documents using platform-specific viewers.
avoid_when: You need web, macOS, Windows, or Linux support (currently not supported by this package).
You need to implement advanced PDF text searching within the view.
strengths: Uses native platform PDF renderers (AndroidPdfViewer and PDFKit).
Provides a robust controller for programmatic navigation, zooming, and screenshots.
Supports customizable options like night mode, swipe directions, and fit policies.
weaknesses: Only supports Android and iOS platforms currently.
Platform views on Android can occasionally introduce layout constraints or require hybrid composition considerations.
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum Flutter 3.32.0 / Dart 3.8.0. iOS requires support > 12.0.
